description: This file defines the Banner controller class for the OpenCart admin module, handling banner configuration, including rendering the banner settings page, saving, adding, and deleting banner modules.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing banner modules in the OpenCart admin panel, including rendering the banner configuration page and handling CRUD operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the banner configuration page with current settings and available banners.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving banner module settings, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new banner module with default settings.
